title: ANU Research Degree Scholarships, Round 2 (2027)
about: ANU's second research scholarship round, open to international and domestic applicants, closes 15 April for students commencing by 31 August of the same year. The University Research Scholarship base stipend for 2027 is listed at $40,475 per annum.
requirements: For research students commencing in the same year by 31 August
Applications must be complete by the closing date; incomplete applications are not assessed

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Research degrees (PhD/MPhil), all fields" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
